# Boars on the Downs

*The boars on the Thyme Banks are the same breed as the pack Aylwin faced on the road to Kaldemor, and they are getting closer to the road. Defeat 30 of them and bring back 5 tusks for his grandfather.*

## Objectives

- Defeat 30 [Downs Boar](../monsters/downs_boar.md) in [The Thyme Banks](../maps/thyme_banks.md)
- Bring 5 [Boar Tusk](../items/downs_boar_tusk.md) (taken)

## Rewards

- 3,000 EXP
- 440 mesos
- [Orange Potion](../items/orange_potion.md) x10
- +20 standing with Selsior
- +100 standing with [Aylwin](../npcs/aylwin.md)
